dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 09, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Braves Hammer Pirates in 10-5 Thriller**

The Atlanta Braves exploded for 10 runs in a dominant win over the Pittsburgh Pirates, led by Matt Olson's strong effort at the plate. In the Braves' 10-5 victory, Drake Baldwin and Mike Yastrzemski also had big days, with Yastrzemski hitting a grand slam in the win. On the mound, the Braves' staff combined for a strong performance to secure the win. Meanwhile, in a separate game, Juan Soto hit his 21st home run of the season for the New York Mets in a 7-3 win over the Kansas City Royals.
